_comment: Copy to config/app.json (gitignored) OR set CFINTEL_* env vars. Precedence: env > app.json > a company's ats_config > default. Env key format: CFINTEL_<UPPER_SNAKE of the dotted key>, e.g. secrets.brave_api_key -> CFINTEL_SECRETS_BRAVE_API_KEY.

security._comment: When set, every /tasks/*.cfm requires ?key=<task_key>. Leave blank to keep tasks open (local dev). Set via CFINTEL_SECURITY_TASK_KEY in production.
